substantive_insights: Conflict arose from clashing practical interests: D's cooking habit vs A's need for an odor-free workspace and others' laundry concerns.
Options were limited by physical constraints (no alternative cooking areas, weak hood, landlord forbids changes), which steered parties toward scheduling and notification as viable solutions.
Resolution relied on a temporal accommodation (weekends-only) plus communication (D will notify), rather than elimination of the activity.
